_note: Demo broadcasts for `pnpm build:demo`: one sample segment per shift on each channel, so every team appears. Invented sample stories, not real news. Regenerate the audio with demo/generate.py.

segments.headline: Breakfast: sample headlines
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Kofi and Tom  ·  Sample stories only
lines: Good morning! It's breakfast on Pixel Art News. I'm Kofi Mensah.
And I'm Tom Hale. Coffee's on, and this morning's stories are all samples, because this is a demo.
An imaginary summit has agreed to keep talking. Which, at this hour, I can respect.

segments.headline: Weather: a sample forecast
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Sample weather  ·  Data on air from Open-Meteo
lines: Now, the weather. Tom, it's a sample forecast this morning, but what's it looking like?
Wet in the north, Kofi. Rain for Edinburgh and Manchester, and showers over Belfast.
Further south it brightens up, with sunshine for Plymouth and around fifteen degrees in London.
Umbrellas up north, sunglasses down south. Classic.

segments.headline: Daytime: talks run late into the night
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Margot and Tom  ·  Sample story
lines: Good afternoon. I'm Margot Lane, with Tom Hale.
In our sample story, negotiators at an imaginary summit have agreed to keep talking past midnight.
And when talks run late, Margot, it usually means both sides think a deal is close.

segments.headline: Evening: the day's sample headlines
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  The evening news with Margot and Kofi
lines: Good evening, this is Pixel Art News. I'm Margot Lane.
And I'm Kofi Mensah. Tonight's stories are samples: when we go live, it's the real news, with every source linked on screen.
Because you should always be able to check what we tell you.

segments.headline: Overnight: the world while you sleep
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Tom Hale
lines: Good evening, or good morning, depending where you are. I'm Tom Hale.
Overnight, I'll keep an eye on the world while you sleep. Tonight it's sample stories, so it's a quiet one.

segments.headline: Breakfast: tech you'll use today
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Nina and Leo
lines: Morning! Nina Patch here, with Leo Kernel, and the tech you'll actually use today.
Well, sample tech. This is a demo.
So, Leo, in plain English: what's a chip?
The brain inside your phone. A very small, very warm brain.

segments.headline: Daytime: a battery that lasts a week
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Ray and Leo  ·  Sample story
lines: Hey, it's Ray Byte, with Leo. Our sample story: a chip that promises a week of battery.

segments.headline: Evening: hype versus reality
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  The evening tech desk with Ray and Nina
lines: Good evening from a very warm server room! I'm Ray Byte.
And I'm Nina Patch. Ray, this new gadget sounds amazing. What does it cost?
Ah. The sample press release doesn't say.

segments.headline: Overnight: the night shift
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Leo Kernel
lines: Hello from the night shift in the server room. I'm Leo Kernel.
While you sleep, the servers hum, the fans spin, and tonight, the stories are all samples.

segments.headline: Breakfast: from the field to the stars
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Mina and Sam
lines: Good morning! I'm Mina Fields, just back from the field.
And I'm Sam Orbit, just back from staring at the sky all night. It's a demo, so our discoveries are samples.
Clear, and full of things we don't understand yet. Which is the best kind.

segments.headline: Daytime: water vapour on a distant moon
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Ada and Sam  ·  Sample story
lines: Good afternoon, I'm Professor Ada Quark, with Sam Orbit.
In our sample story, a telescope spots what looks like water vapour above a distant moon.
Like seeing breath on a cold morning. It doesn't prove anything is there, but something is going on.

segments.headline: Evening: Lab Notes
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Lab Notes with Ada and Mina
lines: Good evening, and welcome to Lab Notes. I'm Professor Ada Quark.
And I'm Mina Fields. Ada, how sure are we about tonight's sample results?
Not very, Mina. They're samples. Do stay curious.

segments.headline: Overnight: a good night for looking up
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Sam Orbit
lines: Hello, night owls. I'm Sam Orbit.
It's a good night for looking up. And here's the strange bit: the light you see from some stars left them before anyone you know was born.

segments.headline: Breakfast: the morning round-up
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Gus and Jas
lines: Morning, everyone. Gus Ginger here, with Jas Kaur.
Morning, Gus! Overnight there was cricket, football and, for once, no injuries to your pride.

segments.headline: Daytime: late winner sends underdogs through
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Dee and Jas  ·  Sample story
lines: Afternoon! Dee Striker and Jas Kaur. Our sample story: the underdogs win it in the last minute!
And they'd only had one shot on target before that, Dee.
Fresh legs, Jas. Fair play to them.

segments.headline: Evening: the results round-up
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  The evening round-up with Dee and Gus
lines: Evening, everyone. I'm Gus Ginger, and with me as always is Dee Striker.
Evening, Gus! Tonight's results are invented, because it's a demo.
Which means for once, Dee, your predictions can't be wrong.

segments.headline: Overnight: results from around the world
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Jas Kaur
lines: Hello, night owls. Jas Kaur here, with sport from time zones that are wide awake.
Tonight's scores are samples, so I'll spare you the numbers. Just this once.

segments.headline: Breakfast: today's fixtures
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Danny and Lou
lines: Morning, all. Danny Dugout here, with Lou Offside and a cup of tea that's gone cold already.
Morning, Danny! Five fixtures on the board today, all made up, because this is a demo.
Made-up fixtures, Lou. Best kind. Nobody gets sacked.

segments.headline: Daytime: the tactics board
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Ruby and Lou  ·  Sample story
lines: Good afternoon. I'm Ruby Volley, with Lou Offside, and the tactics board is out.
Our sample team pressed high all game, Ruby, and won the ball back in their opponents' half eleven times.
Eleven times. Somebody's been doing their running.

segments.headline: Evening: Full Time
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Full Time with Ruby and Danny
lines: Good evening, and welcome to Full Time. I'm Ruby Volley, and with me is Danny Dugout.
Evening, Ruby. Four live scores up there, and every one of them invented.
So no complaints about the referee tonight, Danny?
Give me time, Ruby. Give me time.

segments.headline: Overnight: goals from around the world
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Lou Offside
lines: Hello, night owls. Lou Offside here, with goals from time zones that are wide awake.
Tonight's replay is a sample, but that net is still bulging. Beautiful.

segments.headline: Breakfast: first practice
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Rory and Tess
lines: Good morning. Tess Grid here, with Rory Pitlane, as the first practice session gets going.
Morning, Tess. Just one car out on track so far. Nice and quiet on the radio.
Enjoy it while it lasts, Rory.

segments.headline: Daytime: lap 42
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Vee and Tess  ·  Sample story
lines: Good afternoon! Vee Apex here with Tess Grid, and we're on lap forty-two of our sample race.
The leader has been out front since the start, Vee, which, in this demo, is a record.
Every record's a record in a demo, Tess.

segments.headline: Evening: qualifying
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Qualifying with Vee and Rory
lines: Good evening! I'm Vee Apex, with Rory Pitlane, and the sun is setting on qualifying.
Track's cooling down, Vee, so the tyres will take a lap to come in.
Patience. And a very fast final sector.

segments.headline: Overnight: the night race
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Tess Grid
lines: Good evening from the overnight pit wall. Tess Grid here, under the floodlights.
It's a sample night race, so the timings are invented, but the city lights are lovely.

segments.headline: Breakfast: odd things before coffee
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Breakfast with Zorp and Mags
lines: Good morning, I'm Mags Moth, with Zorp.
Good morning. Humans eat toast at this hour. I have tried toast. It is warm bread with opinions.
Make of that what you will.

segments.headline: Daytime: town elects a goat as honorary mayor
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Daytime with Rex and Mags  ·  Sample story
lines: Welcome, welcome, welcome to Weird News! I'm Rex Fizz, with Mags Moth!
Our sample scoop: a town has elected a goat as honorary mayor!
Folklore says goats are good luck, Rex. Mind you, folklore says a lot of things.

segments.headline: Evening: the Odd Spot
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  The Odd Spot with Rex and Zorp
lines: It's the evening Odd Spot! A potato that looks exactly like a lighthouse!
I have seen it. It is a potato.
Zorp! Where's your sense of wonder?
On my planet. I left it in a drawer.

segments.headline: Overnight: tales for night owls
segments.ticker: DEMO  ·  Overnight with Mags Moth
lines: Hello, night owls. I'm Mags Moth.
Tonight's strange tales are only samples. But listen closely, and you might hear something odd anyway.
